user.title: Add network storage
user.description: Creates a native Home Assistant backup location. For SMB, paste a Windows Explorer path such as \\truenas\backups\home-assistant; it fills the NAS address and remote share path automatically. SMB needs a remote share path, username, and password; NFS needs an absolute export path. When you submit the form, Home Assistant verifies that the path is reachable and exists.

data.windows_path: SMB path copied from Windows Explorer (optional)

data_description.mount_name: Internal identifier for this location. Use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores; for example: truenas_backups.
data_description.protocol: Choose SMB/CIFS for Windows or TrueNAS-style shares, or NFS for an NFS export.
data_description.windows_path: Optional shortcut for SMB. Paste a path copied from Windows Explorer, for example: \\truenas\backups\home-assistant. It fills the NAS address and remote share path.
data_description.server: Hostname or IP address of the NAS; for example: truenas.local or 192.168.1.20.
data_description.share: SMB remote share path. Subfolders are supported; for example: backups/home-assistant.
data_description.path: Absolute path exported by the NFS server; for example: /mnt/tank/backups/home-assistant.
data_description.username: Account with write access to the selected SMB location; for example: homeassistant.
data_description.password: Password for the SMB account. It is sent to the Supervisor mount manager and is never exposed by this integration.
data_description.make_default: Use this location automatically as the default native Home Assistant backup destination.

error.invalid_mount_name: Use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores for the name.
error.invalid_nfs_path: The NFS export path must start with /.
error.windows_path_cifs_only: A Windows Explorer path can only be used with SMB/CIFS.
error.invalid_windows_path: Enter a Windows network path starting with \\.
error.windows_path_needs_share: Use a share path such as \\server\share or \\server\share\subfolder.
error.mount_name_exists: A Supervisor mount already uses this name.
error.mount_failed: The network path could not be reached or does not exist.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not contact the Supervisor or NAS.

abort.supervisor_required: Network Storage Manager requires Home Assistant OS or a supervised installation.
